// diagnostic

E0202

The write-access marker `&` is required at call site — write access not granted

What

The write-access marker `&` is required at call site — write access not granted

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0202

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0202: tests/ui/missing_mut_call.stderr.

Error [E0202]: parameter `x` requires the write-access marker `&` at the call site
  --> tests/ui/missing_mut_call.jet:7:11
    |
  7 |     touch(x)
    |           ^
 Why: `touch` needs to edit this value with the write-access marker `&`; passing it without that marker grants only read access
 Fix: write the write-access marker `&` (`&x`) when calling `touch`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0202
